derived.prompt: Are the temporal lobe and the caudate lobe parts of the same organ?
bridge: The caudate lobe is a lobe of the liver.
derived.fact: The temporal lobe and the caudate lobe are not parts of the same organ.
chain: The temporal lobe is a lobe of the liver. (edit)
A lobe of an organ is part of that organ (lobe_of is a subproperty of part_of), so the temporal lobe is part of the liver.
The caudate lobe is a lobe of the liver. (stored), so it is part of the liver too.
So both are parts of the same organ: yes.

chain: The temporal lobe is a lobe of the liver. (edit)
The liver is part of the digestive system. (stored)
A lobe of an organ is part of every organ system the organ is part of (lobe_of then part_of gives part_of).
So the temporal lobe is part of the digestive system: yes.

chain: Wernicke's area is in the brain. (stored, by name)

So the organ is the brain.
Wernicke's area is in the temporal lobe. (stored, by description)
The temporal lobe is a lobe of the liver. (edit)
So Wernicke's area is in the liver.

related.prompt: Are the temporal lobe and the parietal lobe lobes of the same organ?

chain: The temporal lobe is a lobe of the liver. (edit)

A lobe is a lobe of one organ (lobe_of is functional) and the liver is not the brain, so the two lobes are not lobes of the same organ: no.

notes: ABox revision, stored edit on lobe_of (subproperty of part_of, with the role chain lobe_of then part_of): the temporal lobe is a lobe of the liver. The edit crosses organs on purpose (a counterfactual need not be plausible). Related: whether the temporal lobe and the parietal lobe belong to the same organ (composition through the parietal lobe's organ). Derived: subproperty (same organ as the caudate lobe), role chain (part of the digestive system) and transitivity through the hippocampus. The one indeterminate query asks which organ Wernicke's area is in (background beliefs): stored by organ it stays in the brain, placed through the temporal lobe it moves with the lobe to the liver. Known weakness: derived[3] with world w1 (the area stays in the brain while its lobe is part of the liver) conflicts with the transitivity of part_of used in derived[2]. Paired with the contraction biology-delete-0014.
